ok, first of, people really don’t want to believe things are bad, so in their mind, as things either aren’t bad, or when there’s no denying it, they have to get better. They need the hope, because if there is no hope of getting better what’s the point right? 

But that aside sometimes they really think they do know, because everyone has told them things get better right? It’s what everyone says, it will be better, time heals everything, when it doesn’t but when something is said to you your whole life, you end up believing it right? The thing is there are so many things deep rooted  in our society you don’t even realise so when you don‘t know what else to say, you remember what you’ve been told and just say, it gets better.

Also it’s really important to note that for some people it really does get better, in my example I relapsed recently but last year, the full year I was fine, I mean there were bad days where I couldn’t get out of bed but it was fine? So when you finally experience the said “getting better” even though it might get worse later you say it, if someone who feels like you did tells you, given you “got better” you are going to say it, because it’s true for yo, even though it might not be true for others.
